text:
Updated and re-checked `header.json`, `units-001.json` (`U05`), and `units-003.json` (`U26`) with `plan-lint`:

- **`header.json` & `U05` (`packages/element/src/bounds.ts`)**: `getArrowheadAngle` now has signature `(arrowhead: Arrowhead, size?: number, arrowheadSize: ArrowheadSize = DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE): Degrees` and resolves `const resolvedSize = size ?? getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, arrowheadSize)` inside the function body.
- **`U26` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx`)**: Added `Keyboard` to the `./helpers/ui` import, a rule asserting that a single `Keyboard.undo()` after an arrowhead size change restores the previous `arrowheadSize`, and the corresponding test entry.
